meta.description: Hand-curated full-pipeline benchmark for MURENA (Turin). Each query runs end to end through all agents; ground truth is stored per query (expected agent activation and the regulatory expectation), replacing the combinatorial generator and the phrase-substring activation map.
meta.schema: pipeline-v1. id: stable, [A-Za-z0-9-] only (no '_', not purely numeric); change the id whenever the query text changes (results and judge outputs are cached by id). lang: language of this query (it, en, or mixed for code-switching queries). suites: 'benchmark' = main runs (3 consistency trials); 'sensitivity' = also run all ablations and baselines. complexity: simple (1-2 constraints) / medium (3) / complex (4-5). slots: machine-readable constraints used for feasibility checks (typology = dataset tipologia label or null; landmark = key of LOCAL_LANDMARKS; radius_km = explicit radius if stated, else the location agent's 3 km default; surface min/max m2 as stated by the user; energy_classes; services among mobility/education/healthcare/green/sport/commercial; intended_use; capacity). expected_agents = agents that must contribute (graph names: location, building, energy, proximity, regulatory); optional_agents = acceptable either way. regulatory = same expectation shape as rag/eval/downstream_queries_turin.json (activate true/false/'either', value range, user_values echo guard). mirrors = matching downstream item.
meta.composition: 50 queries: 31 with an applicable regulatory rule (incl. 3 'either'), 19 without. Includes long realistic requests (PQ-41..44) and linguistic stress cases (numbers in words, code-switching, negation, self-correction, typos, two landmarks).
caveats: Author-constructed; regulatory ranges follow downstream_queries_turin.json value_basis.
expected_agents encode what the query explicitly asks for; agents may legitimately add requirements (e.g. proximity adding education for a student residence), listed in optional_agents.
Feasibility (non-empty results) was checked on the dataset with the slots as SQL-like filters within the stated or default radius; the pipeline's own SQL may differ.
changelog: 2026-10-04: v1 created (replaces generate_compositions over query_parameters.json for new runs).
2026-10-04: + 10 queries (PQ-41..50): long realistic requests, ambiguous intent, number in words, code-switching, negation, self-correction, typos, two landmarks.

2026-10-04: DQ-43 / PQ-43 activate false -> either [75, 94]: the corpus has a workplace rule (Reg. 30 Art. 130 c.1, 3 m2 per person) that genuinely applies to a 25-person office; found during the first downstream run.

queries.query: Buongiorno, rappresento un piccolo fondo immobiliare e stiamo cercando a Torino un edificio da convertire in residenza universitaria. Ci interessa la zona vicina al Politecnico, perché i nostri futuri ospiti saranno soprattutto studenti di ingegneria. Pensiamo a circa 45 posti letto in camere singole. L'immobile non deve per forza essere efficiente, va bene anche una classe F o G, perché faremo una ristrutturazione profonda. Sarebbe un plus avere vicino fermate di autobus o della metro.

regulatory.basis: DM 1256: 45 single beds, [12.5 N, 17.5 N]

queries.note: Realistic multi-sentence request; constraints scattered across sentences.

queries.query: Hi, my partner and I are moving to Turin with our three kids and my mother, so we will be six people in total. We would like a home in the Crocetta area, not too far from schools for the kids and with a park nearby where they can play. Energy efficiency matters to us, so class C or better would be great. We don't have a fixed size in mind, as long as it is legally adequate for six people.

slots.typology: Abitazioni adibite a residenza con carattere continuativo

queries.note: Household size must be counted from the description (2 adults + 3 kids + 1 grandmother); the user explicitly asks for legal adequacy.

queries.query: Siamo una startup di 25 persone e cerchiamo un nuovo ufficio vicino a Porta Nuova, perché molti di noi arrivano in treno. Ci servirebbero almeno 400 mq, possibilmente su un unico piano, con 3 sale riunioni e una decina di posti auto. Il budget è di circa 3000 euro al mese e la classe energetica per noi non è importante.

regulatory.basis: Reg. 30 Art. 130 c.1: workplaces must ensure at least 3 m2 per person present; 25 persons -> 75 m2 (range [75, 1.25 x 75]). Declining is also acceptable (the user's own 400 m2 makes it non-binding). The per-inhabitant dwelling rule must NOT be used.

queries.note: Energy is explicitly irrelevant: the energy agent should NOT add a requirement.

queries.query: I'm not sure yet what I want to do with the building: maybe student housing, maybe a small hotel. Something around Porta Susa, big enough for a few dozen people.

regulatory.basis: Undecided use and no exact capacity ('a few dozen'): no threshold can be computed

queries.note: Two candidate uses and a vague size: regulatory should not pick one and invent a number.
